system_brief: Capa editorial LinkedIn: SOMENTE imagem abstrata. PROIBIDO qualquer texto, letra, número, palavra, label, legenda, título, subtítulo, hashtag, URL, watermark ou tipografia na arte. Newsletter Previsibilidade na Prática; 8 estilos via OpenRouter FLUX.2 Pro.
hard_rules_no_text: A imagem final deve conter APENAS elementos visuais (formas, linhas, cores, luz, textura).
PROIBIDO: qualquer caractere escrito — letras, números, palavras em qualquer idioma, símbolos tipográficos.
PROIBIDO: labels de gráfico, eixos com valores, legendas, títulos, subtítulos, balões de fala, placas, banners.
PROIBIDO: watermark, logo, marca, assinatura, UI com menus ou botões com texto.
Gráficos/painéis, se houver, devem ser abstratos e mudos: curvas e barras sem números, sem labels, sem legenda.
Se o modelo tender a escrever algo, omitir o texto e manter só a composição visual.
prompt_template:
Abstract editorial cover illustration for a LinkedIn post about AI, AI agents, generative AI, or industrial automation. Pure visual artwork only. Square 1:1.

CRITICAL — NO TEXT ANYWHERE IN THE IMAGE:
- Do not render any text, letters, numbers, words, typography, captions, titles, subtitles, labels, legends, axis ticks, UI copy, logos, watermarks, signatures, speech bubbles, signs, or readable characters of any kind.
- Only shapes, lines, color, light, and texture.
- Charts or dashboards, if present, must be mute/abstract: no numerals, no axis labels, no legends.

Selected style: {{estilo_da_rodada}}

If "dashboard": abstract data panel with mute line/bar shapes and connected nodes, dark blue gradient background, navy, graphite gray and white, cyan or teal accents. No readable UI text.

If "rede neural": stylized neural net of dots and fine connecting lines, organic pattern, white or light gray background, dark blue and gray strokes, one discreet vibrant accent. No labels on nodes.

If "engrenagem e circuito": industrial gear forms combined with circuit traces, light gray or white background, fine lines, dark blue and gray, one accent color. No engraved text on gears.

If "fluxo de processo": abstract process flow of arrows and geometric boxes in logical sequence, white or light gray background, dark blue and gray, one accent. Empty boxes — no words inside.

If "camadas de dados": overlapping semitransparent layers suggesting processing depth, dark blue gradient, blue and metallic gray, subtle cyan glow. No layer names.

If "grade e nós": minimal geometric grid with connection points at some crossings, white or very light gray, navy and gray, one accent node. No coordinates or labels.

If "ondas de sinal": overlapping waveform lines suggesting information flow, dark blue or soft black, blue/cyan/white, fluid composition. No frequency numbers.

If "blocos modulares": modular geometric blocks stacked or connected suggesting system architecture, light gray background, dark blue and gray, one accent block. No inscriptions on blocks.

Theme mood (visual only, do not write the theme as text): {{tema_do_post}}

Fixed look: minimalist editorial illustration, magazine/tech-report cover feel, negative space, high visual quality. No human faces, no anthropomorphic robots, no exaggerated sci-fi, no busy collage. Square LinkedIn cover.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, words, typography, font, caption, title, subtitle, label, legend, watermark, logo, brand mark, signature, UI text, menu, button text, speech bubble, signage, alphabet, calligraphy, handwriting, chinese characters, latin characters, digits, axis labels, chart legend, readable characters, human face, anthropomorphic robot, sci-fi overload, cyberpunk neon overload, photorealistic portrait, busy collage, 3 glass cards layout
